lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Duskbarrow, city of crypts. Its bishop came home|with a stone, and the dead got up to meet it.
lines.text: Duskbarrow, city of crypts. Its bishop came home with a stone, and the dead got up to meet it.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Every grave here, I dug, or my father did.|They know my shovel. They don't know this.
lines.text: Every grave here, I dug, or my father did. They know my shovel. They don't know this.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: They are yours, Bishop.|Take them back. Use me. Just a little.
lines.text: They are yours, Bishop. Take them back. Use me. Just a little.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: A little. You always say a little.
lines.text: A little. You always say a little.

lines.speaker: shade
lines.subtitle: Bishop, the Old Ossuary is open.|The dead are wearing amber.
lines.text: Bishop, the Old Ossuary is open. The dead are wearing amber.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Then we put them back to bed.|Gently. They were somebody's.
lines.text: Then we put them back to bed. Gently. They were somebody's.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: There. Doesn't that feel like|enough? It never is. Again.
lines.text: There. Doesn't that feel like enough? It never is. Again.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I know what you are. You're the|last biscuit in the tin, forever.
lines.text: I know what you are. You're the last biscuit in the tin, forever.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Rest. I'm sorry they woke you.|It wasn't me. It was what I was holding.
lines.text: Rest. I'm sorry they woke you. It wasn't me. It was what I was holding.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Father. You taught me where to dig.|You never taught me when to stop.
lines.text: Father. You taught me where to dig. You never taught me when to stop.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Use me, and he will stand up and answer you.|One question. Any question.
lines.text: Use me, and he will stand up and answer you. One question. Any question.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I'm learning, late. You'd say that's|the family way. Sleep, old man.
lines.text: I'm learning, late. You'd say that's the family way. Sleep, old man.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: Bishop. You taught me the knife.|The stone taught me the rest.
lines.text: Bishop. You taught me the knife. The stone taught me the rest.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: Give it to me. You never use|it right. You use it SMALL.
lines.text: Give it to me. You never use it right. You use it SMALL.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: That's the only way to use it,|Hush. Small. Then never.
lines.text: That's the only way to use it, Hush. Small. Then never.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: There is always another night, Bishop!
lines.text: There is always another night, Bishop!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: There is. I'd like to sleep through one of them.
lines.text: There is. I'd like to sleep through one of them.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: You'll want me back. When the dark gets loud.
lines.text: You'll want me back. When the dark gets loud.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Go, then. Keep your knives sharp.|I may need a friend who isn't a rock.
lines.text: Go, then. Keep your knives sharp. I may need a friend who isn't a rock.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: You will use me at the end.|Everyone does. Your Master did.
lines.text: You will use me at the end. Everyone does. Your Master did.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Then I'll be the first who didn't.|I do so like being first.
lines.text: Then I'll be the first who didn't. I do so like being first.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: I'm not using you. I'm carrying you.|Like a parcel. To the hole you came from.
lines.text: I'm not using you. I'm carrying you. Like a parcel. To the hole you came from.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The Bishop walked out of his city with the stone|in his fist, and for once the fist stayed shut.
lines.text: The Bishop walked out of his city with the stone in his fist, and for once the fist stayed shut.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Hungry... to the very last...
lines.text: Hungry... to the very last...

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Not once? Not ONCE? ...What ARE you?
lines.text: Not once? Not ONCE? ...What ARE you?

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.subtitle: Full, apparently. Who knew.
lines.text: Full, apparently. Who knew.
